name: Spinach Corn Pasta Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C. Cook the pasta for 2 minutes less than the pack says; drain.
Heat the oil and cook the garlic for 30 seconds. Add the spinach until wilted, then the passata, corn, herbs and tofu; simmer for 5 minutes.
Mix the pasta into the sauce with the nutritional yeast and seasoning.
Transfer to a baking dish and top with the mozzarella.
Bake for 20 minutes until bubbling and golden.
note: Chickpea pasta roughly doubles the protein of regular pasta; use a modest portion and plenty of vegetables.
